Closes #<issue>

## Outcome and scope

- Problem/requirement and resulting behavior (or documentation correction):
- Source of truth, owning layer and acceptance criteria:
- Boundaries/contracts affected; migrations or compatibility considerations:

## Verification

- Commands run and actual results (include RED/GREEN for behavior changes):
- Failed/unavailable checks and cause; distinguish current results from old receipts:
- Documentation-only: factual/link checks instead of artificial behavior tests:

## Harness steering (when fixing a recurring mistake)

- Smallest violating example and failing proof:
- Sensor/regression and permitted/forbidden fixtures, or explicitly pending enforcement:
- Local guide changed to prevent recurrence:

## Review and rollback

- Remaining findings, manual semantic judgments and scope/abstraction trade-offs:
- Rollout/rollback and temporary allowances to retire (owning issue + condition):

Human review precedes merge. Passing checks do not establish untested semantics.
